periods.time: Final day before and during the championship
periods.label: 唤醒史黛菈自傲的夜叉姬

status.current: watches her pupil Stella's final from special seating
status.condition: casual but ready to intervene if needed

relationships.stella-vermillion: Recent pupil; Nene's brutal training awakened Stella's pride and Dragon Spirit.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: Old rival/friend whose deadly final she remembers.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Stella's opponent whom she calls dangerous but exciting.

periods.summary: Nene declines commentary work so she can watch Stella, her beloved recent pupil, from a prime seat. She and Kurono discuss how Stella's hidden dragon power emerged through training and how the duel may require life-risking intervention if it spirals out of control. During the final she observes the lovers' rivalry through the lens of her own youthful rivalry with Kurono and recognizes their joy as knights.

key_events.summary: Watches over Stella's rest and agrees to help if the duel becomes too dangerous.
Compares Ikki and Stella's soul clash to her own rivalry with Kurono.

periods.time: Night meeting at Osaka Bay Dome after Seven Stars
periods.label: 现存日本魔人之一

status.current: identified as one of Japan's Desperado
status.condition: acts as witness and senior fighter at Tsukikage's meeting

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Student newly awakened into the same realm.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: Colleague whom she needles about a past fear-based awakening.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Listens to his confession and future vision.

periods.summary: Nene attends Tsukikage's secret Bay Dome meeting and supports the decision to let Ascaride test Ikki and Stella, arguing that experience against top League fighters is valuable. Tsukikage identifies her as one of the two Japanese mage-knights who have become Desperado, alongside Nango Torajiro. Her teasing remark about someone who awakened through fear and retired soon after causes visible tension with Kurono.

key_events.summary: Is named as a Japanese Desperado during Tsukikage's explanation.
Witnesses the future-Tokyo vision and Tsukikage's confession.

periods.time: Caldia battle after League emergency mobilization
periods.label: 以霸道天星介入的夜叉姬

status.current: on Caldia battlefield confronting Naseem until Or-Gaule interrupts
status.condition: uninjured; clothing partly torn by Naseem's provocation

relationships.stella-vermillion: Student she saves and warns not to fight Naseem yet.
relationships.naseem-salim: Enemy and prospective Desperado opponent; she can strike him by compressing his sand body with gravity.
relationships.norman-creed: Responds ahead of broader League mobilization arranged by the League's chancellor/vice leadership.

periods.summary: Nene arrives at Caldia before the main League reinforcements by riding/using a meteor-like descent. Her forbidden technique Tyrant Star interrupts Naseem's right-handed strike and prevents immediate devastation, though he survives without serious injury. She tells Stella that the League is mobilizing as many knights and armies as possible, with up to a million reinforcements expected, and that she came early because waiting would be too slow. Nene explains that Naseem's power is not mere sand but dehydration, and demonstrates a way to damage him: compress his dispersing body with a gravity field. She prepares to fight him seriously, but Or-Gaule interrupts the battle with Lunaeyes' declaration.

key_events.summary: Saves Stella with Tyrant Star and teaches the nature of Naseem's dehydration ability.
Her fight with Naseem is stopped by Or-Gaule's political intervention.

periods.time: After Caldia and before the representative war
periods.label: 夜叉姬的备战与见证
periods.affiliation: International Mage-Knight League; Hagun Academy; Vermillion side

status.current: ready to fight Naseem and the Quedland representatives
status.condition: battle-focused, training alone with ominous horn-like aura

relationships.stella-vermillion: Teacher who warns Stella cannot fight Desperado opponents yet, then later confirms her growth.
relationships.naseem-salim: Enemy she expects to fight after provoking him into the representative-war framework.
relationships.sirius-vermillion: Reassures him while preparing to train at Caldia.
relationships.lunaeyes-vermillion: Interrogates the price Lunaeyes paid Or-Gaule.

periods.summary: Nene sees through the representative-war negotiation, arguing that Or-Gaule would not accept ordinary advantage and that Lunaeyes must have paid a devilish price. She pressures the League to accept the hostage-like arrangement, then joins Vermillion's roster and rejects Sirius as nonviable. Nene warns that Stella, as she is, would die within minutes against Or-Gaule and offers harsh survival training, but Stella refuses and instead goes to Edelberg. Nene lets her go, partly because she hopes Stella may surpass expectations. Nene then chooses to train alone in ruined Caldia, entering a frightening combat state marked by the illusion of black horns. When Stella returns, Nene tests her with Desperado pressure and sees she can pass through it.

key_events.summary: Agrees to play along with Or-Gaule's representative-war arrangement to protect civilians.
Joins the roster and warns Stella about the Desperado gap.
Heads to Caldia for extreme solo preparation.
Tests Stella on her return and acknowledges the Edelberg growth.

periods.time: Vermillion funeral night and representative-war opening
periods.label: 醉态豪放仍迎战沙漠死神的夜叉姬
periods.affiliation: International Mage-Knight League; Hagun Academy; Vermillion representative team

status.current: dueling Naseem Salim in the Luxel gate battlefield
status.condition: appears cheerful and uninhibited before battle; serious once Naseem charges
status.goal: defeat Naseem and keep him from rampaging through the team

personality.summary: Loud, indulgent and playful off duty, yet absolute and fearless when confronting another Desperado.

relationships.naseem-salim: Enemy and matched Desperado opponent; his obsession with her drives the prewar League massacre and opening charge.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Student and teammate; Stella worries about Nene's drinking but relies on her strength.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Teammate and former training superior figure.
relationships.or-gaule: Enemy faction leader whose team includes Naseem.

periods.summary: At Vermillion's funeral wake, Nene eats the malformed takoyaki that Stella cannot bring herself to eat, drinks heavily, and becomes popular with Vermillion citizens for her hearty appetite and loud charm. Stella worries that Nene will be too drunk to fight the next day, but Nene brushes her off despite obviously slurred behavior. The next day, during the representative war opening, Naseem immediately rushes the Vermillion team and invokes Mictlan Tormenta. While the sandstorm hurls the other four representatives into the sky, Nene alone remains in place by using gravity on herself. She answers Naseem's eagerness with Earth Binding Formation, multiplying the pressure around him roughly a hundredfold, and then meets his fist with her iron fan. Their first collision releases enormous magical shockwaves that overwhelm cameras and prevent normal observation, establishing their duel as a clash between two Desperado-level monsters separate from the other battlefields.

key_events.summary: Provides comic relief at the wake by drinking and eating with the citizens.
Resists Naseem's opening sandstorm and begins a direct Desperado duel.
